title: 2023 Panini Select - Concourse Black & Green Prizm Die-Cut #46 Trevor Lawrence

descriptionText: This is a 2023 Panini Select football trading card featuring Trevor Lawrence of the Jacksonville Jaguars. It is a Concourse Black & Green Prizm Die-Cut parallel card numbered 46 from the set. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Panini for the 2023 season.
